family: Data connectivity, integration, transformation and orchestration
phase: LATER_CAPABILITY; internal custody dependency only now
accountable_owning_layer: Existing source-domain application/adapter owners; platform integration boundary
intended_acceptance_outcome: An admitted connector/transformation produces typed, attributable source revisions with bounded replay, provenance, error and repair behavior.
preservation_obligation: Keep native business intent distinct from ingested/source facts; immutable source IDs, schema versions, owner receipts and current authorization; custody is not a shipped ingest product.
invalidation_trigger: Import overwrites native truth; new connector bypasses owner; source key or time semantics incompatible with native schema.

family: Ontology objects, typed properties, links and interfaces
accountable_owning_layer: Existing ontology application/kernel contracts plus canonical domain-owned projections
intended_acceptance_outcome: Selected objects and typed commands retain identity, field meaning, relationship integrity, provenance and authorized reusable views; later leaves have their own acceptance.
preservation_obligation: Stable object/type/property/item IDs; schema and revision references; exact units/time; current field/resource policy; one canonical domain writer.
invalidation_trigger: New type requires reinterpreting existing IDs, replacing property meaning, changing legal Company boundary or bypassing canonical writer.

family: Actions, functions, validation, automation and effect receipts
accountable_owning_layer: Existing ontology application dispatch with fixed domain participants and owner adapters
intended_acceptance_outcome: Each admitted first-slice action validates current inputs/authority, preflights without mutation, commits once and returns only the currently authorized projection of the original outcome/receipt on replay.
preservation_obligation: Closed versioned command semantics, owner dispatch, expected revisions, deterministic encoding, preflight/current policy, effect versus notification distinction.
invalidation_trigger: New automation executes arbitrary callbacks, changes old sealed command semantics, introduces a second writer or turns receipt replay into a new action.

family: Drafts, change history, snapshots, replay and finalization
accountable_owning_layer: Existing ontology/common draft application owner and owning domain receipt/custody boundaries
intended_acceptance_outcome: Save, reopen, restore permitted fields, seal and execute preserve acknowledged input, immutable history and actor/company binding.
preservation_obligation: Stable FieldAddress with parent item IDs; schema/version history; incomplete editor text distinct from typed value; immutable sealed input; restoration appends.
invalidation_trigger: Old schema/receipt bytes rewritten, row addressing becomes positional, history needed later was discarded or account/private custody was collapsed into employment.

family: Shared approvals, work assignment, delegation and continuity
accountable_owning_layer: Existing workflow and governance application owners; Group capacity owner; domain decision owner
intended_acceptance_outcome: Automatic/manual assignment and temporary/permanent transfer maintain one accountable task owner, capacity and current authority, with supervised no-candidate recovery.
preservation_obligation: Task/definition identity, ownership/assignment epochs, attribution, policy-derived eligibility, bounded capacity/fairness and no actor-intent transplantation.
invalidation_trigger: New process requires payroll-only task roles, identity storage roots, unbounded candidate search or sharing one task among multiple accountable owners.

family: Analytics, search, saved explorations, time-series, geospatial and multimodal views
phase: LATER_CAPABILITY; admitted first-slice views only now
accountable_owning_layer: Canonical domain read projections plus existing analytics/application and UI adapters
intended_acceptance_outcome: Each later analytical leaf answers declared questions from authorized data with reproducible units, time, lineage and explicit result limits.
preservation_obligation: Policy-aware projection, linked identity, versioned saved criteria, bounded pagination/aggregation and history availability; do not expose hidden population through derived values.
invalidation_trigger: Analytical scale or semantics require materialization/index changes; saved filters lose historical meaning; aggregates assume access to undisclosed fields.

family: Fusion-like spreadsheets, formulas and enterprise coediting
accountable_owning_layer: Existing ontology object/action contracts consumed by future sheet application/UI owner; owner identity finalized at later admission
intended_acceptance_outcome: Declared formula, structural edit, object writeback, concurrent edit and reconnect cases preserve exact values and defined conflicts under the chosen workload.
preservation_obligation: Stable field/cell/item addressing, exact typed values, versioned formulas/schema/structure, owner-bound actions and current policy; preserve a replaceable collaboration seam.
invalidation_trigger: Formula dependencies, cell identity, structure operations or measured contention cannot be represented without transforming persisted draft/object state.

family: Collaborative documents, communications and policy-bound object links
accountable_owning_layer: Future communication/document application owners with existing object, policy, workflow and Leptos UI boundaries
intended_acceptance_outcome: Later documents and communications preserve authorized links, authorship, audience and delivery state while remaining discoverable beside business work.
preservation_obligation: Independent persistent communication surface; immutable business links, content revisions and authorship; separate audience policy and delivery outcome.
invalidation_trigger: Communication storage treats Employment as login identity, derives authority from job labels or depends on transient payroll inspection panels.

family: Developer APIs, SDKs, application building and integrations
accountable_owning_layer: Existing application use cases; REST/UI sibling adapters where selected; contracts/OpenAPI serialized owner
intended_acceptance_outcome: First-slice SSR/API adapters call the same authoritative use cases; later public tooling preserves versioned contracts and declared compatibility.
preservation_obligation: Server-derived context and policy; transport-independent owner commands/results; versioned DTOs; no universal REST-layer cleanup prerequisite.
invalidation_trigger: An SDK depends on internal custody/control DTOs, transport bypasses owner or compatibility requires rewriting persisted intents.

family: AI platform and model development/operations
accountable_owning_layer: Separate Intelligence repository; Console-owned fail-closed application seam
intended_acceptance_outcome: After stable Intelligence SHA and separate admission, chosen model capabilities use the same Principal, object/action owners and explicit evidence/authority limits.
preservation_obligation: Keep existing bind-only loopback seam; no tenant chat/inference/payroll write or autonomous merge; deterministic business authority remains independent.
invalidation_trigger: A model integration needs a second writer, tenant inference before admission, non-loopback exposure or cloning without named stable base.

family: Security, governance, platform administration, observability and product delivery
accountable_owning_layer: Platform auth/authz, Account/Group, DB/runtime and delivery owners; canonical domain control owners
intended_acceptance_outcome: Selected policy and control changes are attributable/current; diagnostic, recovery, migration and release evidence accurately describe actual effects and exposure limits.
preservation_obligation: Resource/field/action and policy-administration authority; Company isolation; versioned dependency/contract manifests; protected telemetry and effect histories; software rollback distinct from data restoration.
invalidation_trigger: Scope/authority encoding changes, mixed-version reads reinterpret history, telemetry discloses hidden data, deployment requires irreversible conversion or new exposure.

family: Persistent Account and internal/applicant/former-worker/partner identity
accountable_owning_layer: Platform Account/auth/context owners; policy-scoped CompanyActor attribution owners
intended_acceptance_outcome: Account identity persists independently of Employment; separate security suspension, recovery and session-revocation controls remain effective. Current policy controls login eligibility, contexts, own historical records and actions without job-title role classes.
preservation_obligation: Stable Account and attributed actor IDs, separate employment lifecycle, original Company-bound drafts, temporal grants and policy-derived discovery.
invalidation_trigger: Login identity is deleted/recreated on employment change, one Account silently changes legal actor or current context retargets a saved intent.

family: Company, Group, OrgUnit, Person, Employment and organization topology
accountable_owning_layer: Existing Company/organization/HR canonical owners; separately scoped Group topology owner
intended_acceptance_outcome: Company-scoped work and authorized Group observations preserve legal/employment identity, topology and single-writer boundaries.
preservation_obligation: Group tenant versus Company legal/RLS cell; Company-local OrgUnits; immutable historical Employment; N× scoped reads and one-Company writes.
invalidation_trigger: Cross-company shared office becomes a shared OrgUnit, Group arms app.current_org, or a later topology change rewrites historical legal ownership.

family: Recruiting and HR employment lifecycle: appointment, promotion, transfer, departure
phase: LATER_CAPABILITY; selected existing facts and continuity dependencies now
accountable_owning_layer: Existing people/HR application and canonical assignment owners with governance decisions
intended_acceptance_outcome: Each admitted lifecycle story has real input, distinct authorized decision, canonical employment effect, downstream consequences and correction/history acceptance.
preservation_obligation: Person creation distinct from hr.appoint; exact effective intervals and employment identity; persistent Account; no blanket lifecycle shipping from existing code.
invalidation_trigger: Later HR change requires retroactive replacement of Person/Employment identity, drops historical payroll links or conflates directory create with appointment approval.

family: Attendance, calendars, coverage and close/source lifecycle
accountable_owning_layer: Existing attendance/payroll source application and adapter owners
intended_acceptance_outcome: Supported native payroll receives exact calendars, assignments, coverage, close facts and source revisions; stale/incomplete sources route accountable repair.
preservation_obligation: Versioned source facts, exact periods, stable Employment links, qualification/provenance and owner-bound close/reopen behavior.
invalidation_trigger: New attendance story alters prior period/coverage meaning, needs source facts never retained, or bypasses close/freeze semantics.

family: Labor and jurisdiction-dependent employment workflows
accountable_owning_layer: Relevant existing HR/labor/payroll domain owner; qualified rule authority remains separately identified at later admission
intended_acceptance_outcome: Each supported labor story distinguishes verified rule, versioned evidence, assumption and unsupported circumstance, with correction and required authority.
preservation_obligation: Store evidence edition/locator/narrative separately from legal conclusions; preserve exact time/jurisdiction/profile applicability; no guessed statutory rules.
invalidation_trigger: A required rule lacks authoritative confirmation, source applicability changes or new retention/processing obligations conflict with immutable evidence treatment.

family: Native nonpayable payroll input, calculation and human review
phase: FIRST_SLICE_VERTICAL; full payroll story inventory later
accountable_owning_layer: Existing payroll application/domain/adapters and current registered source/workflow participants
intended_acceptance_outcome: One admitted supported numeric journey reaches an approved nonpayable result with complete source and human coverage; exceptional required cases stay visibly incomplete.
preservation_obligation: Exact monetary units/rounding/profile; immutable source and calculation commitments; current evidence; natural-person independence; no partial hidden-population completion.
invalidation_trigger: New profile changes old calculation interpretation, requires guessed inputs or drops unsupported selected employees to claim completion.
dependencies: CF-C01; CF-C02; CF-C04; CF-F03; CF-F04; CF-F05; CF-C12

family: Own historical publication, inquiries and correction continuity
accountable_owning_layer: Existing payroll review/publication owners, common content/custody owner and workflow follow-up participant
intended_acceptance_outcome: Current and former workers access permitted immutable NONPAYABLE_REVIEW publication and submit/track issue coverage through an actual corrected publication.
preservation_obligation: Published amounts distinct from current correction status; historical own policy; issue/item identity; pending work distinct from corrected outcome; no future receipt required to request work.
invalidation_trigger: Later case process repurposes original issue/content IDs, exposes internal task custody or marks corrected without a covering publication.

family: Native messenger and business conversations
accountable_owning_layer: Future communication application owner using existing Account/object/policy contracts
intended_acceptance_outcome: Admitted conversation tasks support authorized participants, object links, message lifecycle and truthful delivery/recovery in a persistent surface.
preservation_obligation: Account-based authorship, policy-bound linked objects/audiences, stable content/message IDs and navigation independent of payroll details.
invalidation_trigger: Retention, conversation membership or per-message access cannot be represented by chosen shared content/policy contracts.

family: Native mail
accountable_owning_layer: Future mail application/integration owner using existing Account/object/policy contracts
intended_acceptance_outcome: Admitted mail tasks preserve correspondence identity, authorized attachments/object links and distinguish queued/sent/failed/unknown delivery.
preservation_obligation: Separate external delivery effects from business receipts, stable correspondence/content references and current attachment/audience policy.
invalidation_trigger: External provider identity, delivery reconciliation, retention or transport requirements conflict with shared custody assumptions.

family: Native calendar and shared scheduling
phase: LATER_CAPABILITY; payroll work calendars remain CF-C04
accountable_owning_layer: Future calendar application owner using existing Account/object/policy contracts
intended_acceptance_outcome: Admitted scheduling tasks express participants, time zones, updates, cancellations and policy-bound relationships without becoming payroll source authority implicitly.
preservation_obligation: Distinguish business attendance calendar facts from communications scheduling; stable event/occurrence identity, effective time and participant policy.
invalidation_trigger: Recurring-event identity/time semantics or scheduling ownership require reinterpreting persisted attendance/workflow facts.

family: Approved external sharing and applicant/partner experiences
phase: LATER_CAPABILITY; historical former-worker own access remains CF-C07
accountable_owning_layer: Existing Account/authz boundaries and future sharing application owner; each domain retains canonical owner
intended_acceptance_outcome: At later admission, an external principal accesses only intended resources/fields/actions for a defined duration with revocation and attribution evidence.
preservation_obligation: No hardcoded external/internal job-title class; persistent Account, exact policy context, revocable links and owned resources; no blanket employee-required model.
invalidation_trigger: Sharing requires bearer-link authority, new identity federation, retention/disclosure rules or cross-tenant writes outside current contracts.

family: Internal evidence custody, storage and later 자료실/document management
accountable_owning_layer: Existing common evidence/custody and domain source owners; later storage application owner identified at its admission
intended_acceptance_outcome: First slice retains and retrieves exact required originals under current policy through review/correction/recovery; later file product has its own acceptance.
preservation_obligation: Immutable evidence references, provenance, retention/pins and governed release; no duplicate mutable payload store; no first-slice import/export data-entry substitute.
invalidation_trigger: Later storage deduplicates away required originals, changes address/hash meaning, introduces cross-Company payload access or deletes still-needed evidence.
